title: Pasta with Asparagus and Guanciale
author: Lorenzo
description: Spring asparagus, crisp guanciale and pecorino in a creamy pasta.
steps: Cut the asparagus into short pieces, keeping the tips apart.
Crisp the guanciale in the oil, add the asparagus stems and cook for 5 minutes, then the tips for 2 more.
Boil the pasta in salted water, toss it in the pan with a ladle of its water, and finish with pecorino and pepper.
